tools.name: singleops_list_operations
tools.description: List the operations (divisions) of the SingleOps account. A lead needs an operation `id` from this list. Read-only.

tools.name: singleops_list_custom_inputs
tools.description: List the custom input fields of the account (for example a 'Lead Source' field). Use the `id` as `custom_input_id` when you create a lead. Read-only.

tools.name: singleops_search_clients
tools.description: Search existing clients by email or phone (prefix match, up to 50 results per page). Search first, then pass the client `id` to singleops_create_lead to avoid a duplicate client. Read-only.

tools.name: singleops_create_lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a new lead in SingleOps (stage Lead). Not idempotent: each call creates a new lead, so do not repeat it. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: singleops_search_clients · Public sink: singleops_search_clients.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: singleops_search_clients · Public sink: singleops_search_clients

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
